explanation: f is piecewise linear, with a finite jump at 0 and finite derivative limits 4 and −2, so it is piecewise smooth. For x≠0, g'(x)=3x²−(3/5)|x|^(−2/5), which tends to −∞ at 0, so g is not piecewise smooth. For h, h'(x)=(10/3)x²∛x for x≠0, and h'(0)=0; this derivative is continuous. Therefore f and h only are piecewise smooth.
